units.source_text: 湍流上空，秋雨又无声无息地飘洒起来。

en.t: Above the rushing current, the autumn rain began to fall silently once more.

units.source_text: 我们被领到二楼八叠大的房间，面对河面睁大了明亮的眼睛。

en.t: We were shown to an eight-mat room on the second floor, and facing the river, we opened our bright eyes wide.

units.source_text: 我走到廊道上，不由得眺望着河流上下游的景象。

en.t: I stepped out into the corridor and could not help gazing at the views upstream and downstream along the river.

units.source_text: 金华山的悠悠绿韵，在对岸的迷离烟雨中看不清了。

en.t: The lingering green charm of Mount Kinka could no longer be made out through the hazy rain on the opposite bank.

units.source_text: 山巅上浮现出仿建的三层楼的天主阁。

en.t: On the mountain peak, a reconstructed three-story castle keep came into view.

units.source_text: 方才的拖船早已溯流而上。

en.t: The towboat from a moment before had long since gone upstream against the current.

units.source_text: 这般景致，令人心旷神怡。

en.t: Such scenery made the heart feel open and refreshed.
